scope.summary: Author breast channel group B (shape/character) per Section 13.17 (BK-17.3, TAI-BK-038/039/040), closing OBR-001's full-space reachability: breast_ptosis (perky -> natural droop, gravity-real at every size), breast_firmness (0.0 natural soft tissue -> 1.0 'fake plastic' implant look: round, high, rigid — a first-class reachable target, not an artifact), breast_profile (teardrop/natural -> round/hemispherical), breast_upper_pole_fullness. The full combination space must be reachable, including extreme-large + perky + natural (where Daz stacking visibly breaks) and extreme-large + fake-plastic-round + perky (archetype b).
acceptance_criteria: Channels breast_ptosis, breast_firmness, breast_profile, breast_upper_pole_fullness are registered as Tissue kind, group_key 'breast', over the breast masks, each with sculpted multi-key tracks and L/R asymmetry sub-channels per the group-A pattern.

Reachability matrix test: the combinations {breast_volume=3.0, breast_ptosis=0.0 (perky), breast_firmness=0.0 (natural)} and {breast_volume=3.0, breast_profile=1.0 (round), breast_firmness=1.0 (implant), breast_ptosis=0.0} both evaluate with the MT-497 mesh-quality assertions green (no collapse, spikes, or crease artifacts per TAI-BK-039).

breast_firmness is flagged physics-coupled in the registry (TAI-BK-040): a typed PhysicsCoupling marker exists on the channel row that 13.20 soft-tissue and 13.19 correctives read mechanically — no hand-tuned per-body physics setup path exists.
All group-B channels pass BODY_DECOUPLE_VALID full-range sweeps (zero displacement outside breast masks).
A 3x3x3 sampled grid over (volume, ptosis, firmness) evaluates without error — 'everything in between' is mechanically demonstrated, not asserted.
scope.risk_if_missed: The operator's verbatim requirement is the full breast-shape space with the fake-plastic bolt-on look as a deliberate target; if firmness/profile/ptosis are entangled or the extreme corners collapse, BodyKit reproduces Daz's exact stacking failure and loses its reason to exist.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > BodyKit shape channels and measurements

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT must wire the shared internal_diagnostics API for its native, job, device, solver-run, or DCC failure modes with bounded structured evidence.
Long-running, native, or external-process work must register bounded progress and child/process identity with the shared Palmistry watcher; Tailor must not fork a watcher.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Separate control independence from declared feathered deformation support, skeletal propagation, physical response, and explicit coupling.
Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.

requirements: Resolve Principal, AuthenticatedSession and AccessSpace before every resource read or mutation.

Use authenticated SurrealDB record-user table/field PERMISSIONS intersected with ResourceBroker-backed artifact/file handles; administrative/root credentials and UI filtering are never the security boundary. PostgreSQL and SQLite access paths are forbidden.
Derived resources preserve the intersection of source access scopes and must not leak existence through counts, search, previews, logs, traces, caches, diagnostics, exports or model context.
